Review of 'Brothers' comedy series starring McConaughey and Harrelson

The comedy series 'Brothers,' starring Matthew McConaughey and Woody Harrelson, features the actors playing fictionalized versions of themselves. The show explores themes of friendship, family, and the possibility of the two longtime friends being related. Reviews describe the series as a tongue-in-cheek comedy that is oddly endearing, charming, and about pals pal-ing around.
